title: Hide All mail and turn All Inboxes off in Settings > Sidebar
steps: Launch with -UseFakeGmail (two fake accounts), press Ctrl-Cmd-S to show the sidebar, then open Settings > Sidebar
Turn All mail off, then in the mail window press G A and afterwards G I
Turn Show All Inboxes off, then press Ctrl-0 and G U; turn both switches back on
Right-click Spam in the sidebar, choose Hide from sidebar, then press Undo in the notice
expected: The All mail row leaves the sidebar at once; G A still opens All mail and its row stays while it is open, then goes after G I. With All Inboxes off the All Inboxes row is gone and Ctrl-0, G U do nothing. Switching it back on restores the row and the keys. Spam leaves the sidebar with a notice naming in:spam; Undo brings it back.
